content.text: Section 24 fully matches the preferred position. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full. 24.1 gives Customer an unconditional right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only). 24.2 restricts Vendor: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct Customer competitor. 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to all other assignments. 24.4 expressly confirms that Customer's change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, and requires Vendor cooperation with administrative changes for a permitted successor. Section 13.3 carries the same carve-out through to licence transfers. No walk-away features are present, and no change-of-control trigger appears elsewhere in the document. No redline needed.
